answer: The plume index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the onyx queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1693 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the marble. Slashing removes 20 percent at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
